findings.problem: Schema validation performs set membership on unvalidated values: request['role'] and value.get('verdict'). A JSON array or object in either field raises TypeError because it is unhashable, rather than NativeRoleError. main does not catch TypeError, so malformed input produces an uncontrolled traceback instead of the documented inconclusive error path. This fails closed but is a concrete validation defect; the supplied tests do not cover these values.
findings.fix: Check that role and verdict are strings before set membership. Add malformed-array/object fixtures requiring NativeRoleError and controlled adapter failure.
